citations.quote:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。

# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。

# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。

report.conclusion: 以下为检索证据摘录（离线测试替身）。

# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可

Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

citations.quote:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。

# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。

# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
